 STOCK EXCHANGE RELEASE 22 October 2026 
 Nokia Corporation
 Interim report
 22 October 2026 at 08:00
EEST
 Nokia Corporation Interim Report for Q3 2026 
 Nokia delivers strong net sales and profit growth 
 · Q3 net sales grew 9% y-o-y on a constant currency basis (+10% reported). 
 · Network Infrastructure net sales grew 15% y-o-y on a constant currency basis, led by IP Networks growing 43% and Optical
Networks 18%. Group net sales to AI & Cloud customers grew 123% and order intake 118%. 
 · Mobile Infrastructure net sales grew 5% y-o-y, in part due to acceleration of revenue from Q4 into Q3. The segment benefited
from product mix, commercial discipline and continued execution of the cost reduction program. 
 · Q3 comparable gross margin was largely stable y-o-y at 44.6%. Reported gross margin declined 220bps to 42.2%. 
 · Q3 comparable operating margin increased 220bps y-o-y to 11.7% benefiting from revenue growth and operating efficiency. Reported
operating margin declined 160bps to 3.8% due to accelerated restructuring and integration cost. 
 · Q3 comparable diluted EPS from continued operations of EUR 0.09; reported diluted EPS from continued operations of EUR
0.03. 
 · Nokia's full year financial outlook is unchanged. 
 "Team Nokia continues to deliver on our commitments as we execute
against our strategy. In Q3, we grew net sales by 9% and improved comparable operating margin by 220 basis points. We continue to simplify
our portfolio, and we are on track to complete the Infinera integration by the end of 2026, one year ahead of plan with EUR 200 million
of net synergies.
 In AI & Cloud, net sales more than doubled year-over-year
and we secured EUR 1.5 billion in new orders. Our strong order backlog also positions us for future growth. We expect our combined Optical
and IP Networks businesses to grow between 25% and 30% in 2027. Nokia’s strengths are uniquely suited to meet growing demands for
AI infrastructure that is larger, more distributed and hyperconnected. We are investing where we can differentiate and co-innovate with
hyperscalers. Our partnership with Google in support of their EUR 13 billion investment in Finland is an example of how our optical and
IP networks provide the critical connectivity AI infrastructure requires.
 AI-native networks are moving into the physical world, and our AI-RAN
platform is being developed to deliver the performance needed for this market. Together with T-Mobile and NVIDIA, we completed the world’s
first AI-RAN call in a live operator network in line with the commitment we announced last year. As we move towards commercial deployment
the features and spectral efficiency delivered by our platform are uniquely differentiated in the market.

 Overall, growth is accelerating, operating leverage is becoming more
visible and I’m confident in the long-term shareholder value Team Nokia is creating."
 Justin Hotard , President and CEO
 This is a summary of the Nokia Corporation Interim Report for Q3 2026
published today. Nokia only publishes a summary of its financial reports in stock exchange releases. The summary focuses on Nokia Group's

report hosted at www.nokia.com/financials . Investors should not solely rely on summaries of Nokia's financial
reports and should also review the complete reports with tables.
